name: A goal record with a target and a budget
purpose: A request becomes a goal record: metric, target, done-standard and a budget no larger than its parent has left.
record: Conformance cases written here (tests/test_orchestrate_parts.py): the default record, a child budget capped by its parent and a parent that has no limit.
disadvantages: A rule-based translation; whether the target is the right one for a request needs reviewed requests with their intended targets.
